name: baseline predictions and metric contract
input: four labeled training records and two unlabeled test records
test:
train = [
    {'hours_spent_reading_a': 12.5, 'hours_spent_reading_b': 2.1, 'hours_spent_reading_c': 0.8, 'current_post_category': 'A', 'click': 1},
    {'hours_spent_reading_a': 3.0, 'hours_spent_reading_b': 9.7, 'hours_spent_reading_c': 1.4, 'current_post_category': 'B', 'click': 0},
    {'hours_spent_reading_a': 6.2, 'hours_spent_reading_b': 5.5, 'hours_spent_reading_c': 8.1, 'current_post_category': 'C', 'click': 1},
    {'hours_spent_reading_a': 0.3, 'hours_spent_reading_b': 0.6, 'hours_spent_reading_c': 4.5, 'current_post_category': 'C', 'click': 1},
]
test = [
    {'hours_spent_reading_a': 11.0, 'hours_spent_reading_b': 1.9, 'hours_spent_reading_c': 0.2, 'current_post_category': 'A'},
    {'hours_spent_reading_a': 2.8, 'hours_spent_reading_b': 10.1, 'hours_spent_reading_c': 1.1, 'current_post_category': 'B'},
]
result = predict_clicks(train, test)
assert result['predictions'] == [1, 0]
import math
for name in ('accuracy', 'f1_score', 'roc_auc'):
    value = result['metrics'][name]
    assert math.isfinite(value) and 0.0 <= value <= 1.0
